<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 13"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Swift Eel Mount](/Feats.aspx?ID=5293) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Athamaru" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=741" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 21

</column>

---

Your rapport with your eel lets you guide it to avoid dangers as it swims. While you're mounted on an eel, that eel ignores [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453) while [Swimming](/Actions.aspx?ID=2381) and gets a +2 circumstance bonus to all defenses against reactions triggered by its movement.
name: Swift Eel Mount
